GRADIENT_SAME.text: Prepare an identified network and measure both independent load fields, preserving every image, load and identity, then report a qualified bondwise gradient estimate.

BEHAVIOR_UNIFORM.text: Fabricate the supplied identified geometry, measure both output-node responses to the specified input, and report the actual response and uncertainty.

REGRESSION_SWEEP.text: Fabricate the supplied final geometry and measure both output nodes over the supplied seven-load sweep, including measured zero and safe recovery.

include: qualified geometry/material/station/tool cards necessary for work
anonymous input case and verified node/load card
newly measured records and declared processing interfaces
exclude: evaluator-only named geometry intent if blinded
blinded_projection_rules: Emit anonymous case token and no species-named branch/key/path
Hide trained-left/right intent if evaluation requires discovering response; provide geometry IDs without expected ordering
Expected species map never embedded in supplied case vector
Entire design package is not an actor prompt
projection_algorithm: Choose evaluator branch privately; emit only its template value plus allowed actual inputs, never the evaluator mapping key or full templates dictionary
